issues.description: Dialog missing DialogTitle/aria-label. Radix will log a console warning and screen readers cannot label the command palette. Add a visually-hidden DialogTitle.
SheetContent missing SheetTitle/aria-label. Same a11y gap as the command palette dialog — screen readers cannot label the mobile nav drawer.

callTool has an automatic retry-on-error (resetSession + re-init). This is good for session expiry recovery but means every tool error triggers a full re-initialization round-trip before surfacing the error to the UI. If the server is returning persistent errors (bad request, not found), the user sees double latency. Consider only retrying on specific HTTP status codes (401, 403, 410) rather than all errors.
Search errors are silently swallowed (.catch(() => setResults([]))). The user sees an empty result set with no indication that the search failed. Consider showing an error state.
Same silent error swallowing on search and recent sessions fetch. Acceptable for a command palette since it's transient UI, but worth noting.
isToolCallBlock heuristic checks for JSON-like content with specific keys. Could false-positive on user messages containing JSON, collapsing them by default. Low impact since user can expand.

strengths: TypeScript is clean — build passes with strict checks (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, verbatimModuleSyntax).
All pages handle loading, error, and empty states consistently with skeleton loaders and error cards.
Mobile responsive: sidebar collapses to a Sheet drawer on md breakpoint, header adapts correctly.
Command palette (Cmd+K) has full keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter), debounced search, and recent sessions.
API client handles both JSON and SSE (text/event-stream) responses from MCP server correctly.
Session management (init handshake, session ID tracking, auto-retry) is well-structured.
Search has debounced input (300ms), source filtering, relevance score visualization.
Stats page shows per-project bar chart with proportional widths — clean data viz.
Message viewer auto-collapses tool call JSON blocks, keeping conversation readable.
Dev proxy correctly injects Bearer auth, forwards Mcp-Session headers bidirectionally, handles CORS.
UI components are standard shadcn/ui — consistent, well-typed, accessible primitives.
CSS design system is thorough: role colors, source colors, surface/border/text tokens, spacing variables.
